title: Characteristics of systems for monochrome and colour television
clause_1_scope: This Indian Standard (IS 11453) prescribes technical specifications, requirements, tolerances, and testing procedures for Characteristics of systems for monochrome and colour television.

clause_2_normative_references.title: Lead-acid storage batteries for motor cycles, auto-rickshaws and similar vehicles

clause_3_terminology: Characteristics of systems for monochrome and colour television

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
